description: Implementation of migration status management and retrieval functions within the WPEFramework plugin, including setting migration status, getting migration status, and retrieving boot type information.

classes.name: MigrationImplementation
classes.description: Class implementing migration status management and boot type info retrieval within the plugin.

methods.name: SetMigrationStatus
methods.description: Sets the migration status by writing the corresponding string to a file and logs the operation.

methods.name: GetMigrationStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current migration status from RFC parameters and maps it to internal enum.

methods.name: GetBootTypeInfo
methods.description: Reads the boot type from a file and maps it to an internal enum.
